title: Trump Urges Vance to Shift Focus from Iran to 'Democrat Corruption' After Midterm Setbacks
snippet: President Donald Trump called on Vice President JD Vance to abandon negotiations with Iran and instead turn his full attention toward targeting Democratic-run U.S. cities following recent Republican election losses.
content:
WASHINGTON — In a dramatic pivot following recent Republican midterm losses, President Donald Trump declared Thursday that the United States no longer needs a diplomatic deal with Iran, urging Vice President JD Vance to instead focus on targeting alleged crime and corruption in Democratic-led cities.

Writing on social media, Trump insisted that cracking down on domestic urban centers could yield far greater financial benefits than any foreign policy agreement. "Our Budget could be quickly BALANCED with the correction of this large scale criminal activity," Trump posted, adding that corruption is deeply rooted in Democratic leadership.

Rift Over Foreign Policy and Midterm Fallout

Trump's comments come amid mounting internal friction over the administration's foreign policy stance. Vice President Vance, who had been tasked with helping resolve the escalating confrontation with Tehran, recently sought to distance himself from the conflict. Following a tough midterm election cycle for Republicans, Vance publicly questioned the financial toll of the Iran war and pointed to it as a key factor in GOP electoral defeats.

Vance, widely regarded as a frontrunner for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination, reiterated that earlier recommendations to end the war represented "sound advice."

Refocusing on Domestic Targets

Trump, however, dismissed the necessity of further talks with Tehran, claiming that the U.S. already maintains firm control over key Iranian financial assets and strategic waterways. Instead, he made clear that he expects his vice president to redirect his primary energy back home.

Since taking office for his second term in January 2025, Trump has repeatedly targeted Democratic-governed municipalities, zeroing in on local immigration enforcement and municipal oversight. By directing Vance to lead a crackdown on blue cities, Trump is signaling that aggressive domestic battles will remain a centerpiece of his administration's second-term agenda.
